three.js 0.186.0 (MIT, see LICENSE), vendored for the page's model preview (gui/viewer.js) so it works offline.

  build/three.core.js

  examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js     (GLTFLoader imports it)
  examples/jsm/utils/SkeletonUtils.js
  examples/jsm/libs/fflate.module.js            (FBXLoader imports it; MIT, by 101arrowz)
  examples/jsm/curves/NURBSCurve.js             (FBXLoader imports it)
  examples/jsm/curves/NURBSUtils.js             (NURBSCurve imports it)

To update: `npm pack three@<version>`, unpack, copy the same files over these, change the version here, and open
the page's preview on a GLB with clips and on an FBX.
